{{Top|leg}}
'''Nightview macrobinoculars''' were a model of night vision [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] designed and manufactured by [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]] in the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
Like all [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], the Nightview's had an internal readout system that showed information on distance and land elevation. Considering the Nightviews were specialized for enhanced nighttime viewing, the daytime resolution suffered accordingly. In terms of nightvision, though, the Nightviews were far superior to other, similar products on the market.
